auth.passwordResetSent: Check your email for password reset instructions.
auth.resetPasswordDescription: Choose a new password with at least 8 characters.

auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account.

welcome.title: Keep a finger on the team's pulse.
welcome.description: Run quick health surveys and retrospectives, and follow the actions that come out of them.
welcome.authUnavailable: Configure VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY to sign in. Pulse does not save data locally.

empty.title: No workspace yet
empty.description: Create a workspace from the workspace menu next to the tabs, or ask its owner to share one with you in Pulse.

errors.unexpectedResponse: The server sent an unexpected response. Reload and try again.

health.prompt: How are you feeling about the team right now?

delivery.prompt: How confident are you that we can deliver our current commitments?

autonomy.prompt: Do you have enough autonomy to do your work effectively?

clarity.prompt: Are our priorities and expectations clear?

workload.prompt: How manageable is your current workload?

collaboration.prompt: How well are we collaborating and supporting each other?

empty.title: No surveys yet
empty.manager: Create a short survey to hear how the team is doing.
empty.member: When a survey opens in this workspace you will be able to answer it here.

create.title: New survey
create.description: Pick the questions the team will rate from 1 to 5.
create.name: Title
create.customPromptPlaceholder: Write a question rated from 1 to 5
create.asksComment: Ask what is helping or hurting the team
create.minimumHint: Results stay hidden until the survey is closed with at least this many answers.

answer.description: Rate each statement from 1 to 5. It takes less than a minute.
answer.comment: What is the main thing helping or hurting the team right now?
answer.commentHint: Optional. Avoid details that would identify you.
answer.privacy: Your answer is anonymous: it is stored without your account and only shown aggregated once the survey closes with at least {{minimum}} answers. Pulse only records that you answered, and you cannot change your answer afterwards.

delete.title: Delete survey?
delete.description: “{{title}}” and all its answers will be deleted for everyone.

results.hiddenWhileOpen: Results appear when the survey is closed, so nobody sees answers while people are still responding.
results.belowThreshold: Only {{responses}} answers were received and this survey needs {{minimum}} to show results, so they stay hidden to protect anonymity.
results.trend: Trend over the last {{points}} surveys for: {{question}}
results.comments: What is helping or hurting the team

empty.title: No retrospectives yet
empty.manager: Plan a retrospective to look back with the team and agree on what to change.
empty.member: When a retrospective is planned in this workspace you will be able to join it here.

create.title: New retrospective
create.description: Set the scene. You will guide the team through each stage.
create.name: Title
create.goalPlaceholder: What do we want to get out of this session?
create.anonymousHint: Nobody sees who wrote each topic. Authors can still edit their own.

prepare.name: Prepare
prepare.facilitator: Check the format and goal, then open the board when the team is ready.
prepare.participant: The facilitator will open the board soon.

collect.name: Collect
collect.facilitator: Everyone adds topics privately. Move on to grouping when people are done.
collect.participant: Add your topics. Others only see them once the facilitator starts grouping.

group.name: Group
group.facilitator: Everyone can now see every topic and group the related ones together.
group.participant: Drag related topics together or use the move menu on each topic.

vote.name: Vote
vote.facilitator: Every topic left on its own became a group. Totals stay hidden until discussion.
vote.participant: Spend your votes on what matters most. You can change them until voting ends.

discuss.name: Discuss
discuss.facilitator: Go through the groups by votes and record what the team agrees on.
discuss.participant: The facilitator takes notes while the team talks through the top groups.

closed.name: Closed
closed.facilitator: This retrospective is closed. You can go back to discussion to amend notes.
closed.participant: This retrospective is closed. Here is what the team agreed.

delete.title: Delete retrospective?
delete.description: “{{title}}” with all its topics, votes and notes will be deleted for everyone.

collect.hidden_one: {{count}} topic from others stays hidden until grouping.
collect.hidden_other: {{count}} topics from others stay hidden until grouping.
collect.topicDescription: Details for the new topic in {{column}}
collect.anonymous: Topics are anonymous: nobody will see who wrote them.
collect.named: Your name is shown next to your topics once the board is revealed.

group.hint: Drop a topic on a group to add it, on a group name to merge groups, or on the empty slot to start a new group.
group.allGrouped: Every topic is in a group.
group.dropNew: Drop a topic here to start a new group
group.name: Name of {{name}}

vote.hint: Totals stay hidden until discussion so nobody follows the crowd.
